response.sql:
WITH bucket_counts AS (
  SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
), shares AS (
  SELECT record_count * 1.0 / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM bucket_counts
), kept AS (
  SELECT share
  FROM shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM((SELECT record_count FROM bucket_counts b WHERE b.timespan IS NULL)), 0) AS total_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) AS average_excess
FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: The request settles NULL timespan as its own bucket; SQLite groups all NULL values together. If no bucket qualifies, the query returns NULL for the two averages and 0 for the count.
